description: Use when an agent needs to see what it has stored: lists up to 100 keys (optionally under prefix) in the namespace of the paying wallet with size, stored_at and expires_at, plus a cursor for the next . Returns the exact paid x402 request for your input (GET /kv/list, $0.001 per call), with the response schema and an example; call that URL with an x402 client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge.
name: kv_list
title: KV list
